data.body: RCA/fix: render_pass_outcomes bounded fuse_state with the same cap as outcomes but did not expose whether fuse decisions were elided; because it sliced before filtering None, callers also could not distinguish diagnostic truncation from absent decisions. Fixed in Gerrit 2943 by filtering None first, rendering the bounded fuse_state, and adding always-present fuse_state_truncated counting non-None decisions dropped by the bound. RED evidence: test_pass_outcomes_bounds_the_fuse_state_collection and test_pass_outcomes_fuse_state_truncation_counts_non_none_elisions failed before the fix due missing marker/short kept list. Verification: focused pass_outcomes tests passed; full make verify passed with PYTEST_WORKERS=2 and GIT_CONFIG_* unset; Gerrit 2943 passed LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 and is merged.
